desc:
🏰 Start small and build the kingdom of your dreams!

🏯 Choose your style: Japanese or medieval!
🏡 Build houses, markets, castles, gardens, and more!
🎨 Design your own layout and shape the land with roads, rivers, trees, and decorations!
💰 Earn money from your buildings to expand and unlock new structures, land, and upgrades!
🚶 Watch villagers walk through the kingdom you create!
⏳ Your buildings keep growing while you’re offline!
🌙 Enjoy your creation through day and night!

What will YOU build?

🔔 Follow for future updates, buildings, and decorations!
